class.name: OcgGpDir
class.brief_description: Describes a unit vector in 3D space. This unit vector is also called "Direction". See Also gce_MakeDir which provides functions for more complex unit vector constructions Geom_Direction which provides additional functions for constructing unit vectors and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of unit vectors.
class.description: ! Describes a unit vector in 3D space. This unit vector is also called "Direction". ! See Also ! gce_MakeDir which provides functions for more complex ! unit vector constructions ! Geom_Direction which provides additional functions for ! constructing unit vectors and works, in particular, with the ! parametric equations of unit vectors.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a direction corresponding to X axis.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Normalizes the vector theV and creates a direction. Raises ConstructionError if theV.Magnitude() <= Resolution.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a direction from a triplet of coordinates. Raises ConstructionError if theCoord.Modulus() <= Resolution from gp.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a direction with its 3 cartesian coordinates. Raises ConstructionError if Sqrt(theXv*theXv + theYv*theYv + theZv*theZv) <= Resolution Modification of the direction's coordinates If Sqrt (theXv*theXv + theYv*theYv + theZv*theZv) <= Resolution from gp where theXv, theYv ,theZv are the new coordinates it is not possible to construct the direction and the method raises the exception ConstructionError.

method.name: SetCoord_1
method.description: For this unit vector, assigns the value Xi to: - the X coordinate if theIndex is 1, or - the Y coordinate if theIndex is 2, or - the Z coordinate if theIndex is 3, and then normalizes it. Warning Remember that all the coordinates of a unit vector are implicitly modified when any single one is changed directly. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if theIndex is not 1, 2, or 3. Standard_ConstructionError if either of the following is less than or equal to gp::Resolution(): - Sqrt(Xv*Xv + Yv*Yv + Zv*Zv), or - the modulus of the number triple formed by the new value theXi and the two other coordinates of this vector that were not directly modified.

method.name: SetCoord_2
method.description: For this unit vector, assigns the values theXv, theYv and theZv to its three coordinates. Remember that all the coordinates of a unit vector are implicitly modified when any single one is changed directly.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate of this unit vector.

method.name: SetY
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Y coordinate of this unit vector.

method.name: SetZ
method.description: Assigns the given value to the Z coordinate of this unit vector.

method.name: SetXYZ
method.description: Assigns the three coordinates of theCoord to this unit vector.

method.name: Coord_1
method.description: Returns the coordinate of range theIndex : theIndex = 1 => X is returned Ithendex = 2 => Y is returned theIndex = 3 => Z is returned Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if theIndex is not 1, 2, or 3.

method.name: Coord_2
method.description: Returns for the unit vector its three coordinates theXv, theYv, and theZv.

method.name: X
method.description: Returns the X coordinate for a unit vector.

method.name: Y
method.description: Returns the Y coordinate for a unit vector.

method.name: Z
method.description: Returns the Z coordinate for a unit vector.

method.name: XYZ
method.description: for this unit vector, returns its three coordinates as a number triplea.

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angular value in radians between <me> and <theOther>. This value is always positive in 3D space. Returns the angle in the range [0, PI]

method.name: AngleWithRef
method.description: Computes the angular value between <me> and <theOther>. <theVRef> is the direction of reference normal to <me> and <theOther> and its orientation gives the positive sense of rotation. If the cross product <me> ^ <theOther> has the same orientation as <theVRef> the angular value is positive else negative. Returns the angular value in the range -PI and PI (in radians). Raises DomainError if <me> and <theOther> are not parallel this exception is raised when <theVRef> is in the same plane as <me> and <theOther> The tolerance criterion is Resolution from package gp.

method.name: Cross
method.description: Computes the cross product between two directions Raises the exception ConstructionError if the two directions are parallel because the computed vector cannot be normalized to create a direction.

method.name: Crossed
method.description: Computes the triple vector product. <me> ^ (V1 ^ V2) Raises the exception ConstructionError if V1 and V2 are parallel or <me> and (V1^V2) are parallel because the computed vector can't be normalized to create a direction.

method.name: CrossCrossed
method.description: Computes the double vector product this ^ (theV1 ^ theV2). - CrossCrossed creates a new unit vector. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if: - theV1 and theV2 are parallel, or - this unit vector and (theV1 ^ theV2) are parallel. This is because, in these conditions, the computed vector is null and cannot be normalized.

method.name: Dot
method.description: Computes the scalar product

method.name: DotCross
method.description: Computes the triple scalar product <me> * (theV1 ^ theV2). Warnings : The computed vector theV1' = theV1 ^ theV2 is not normalized to create a unitary vector. So this method never raises an exception even if theV1 and theV2 are parallel.

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Reverses the orientation of a direction geometric transformations Performs the symmetrical transformation of a direction with respect to the direction V which is the center of the symmetry.]

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a direction with respect to the direction theV which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a direction with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a direction with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a direction. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a direction with a "Trsf" from gp. Warnings : If the scale factor of the "Trsf" theT is negative then the direction <me> is reversed.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
